newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices weakens on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices weakens on low demand.

text.p: Indian cotton prices weakened on Tuesday as domestic mill demand remained low and traders feared overseas demand may turn sluggish if U.S. military strikes on Iraqi positions continued.

In spot deals Bengal-deshi fell by 10 rupees at 825/850 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned slid by 10 to 1,675/1,690 rupees. Gujarat Kalyan medium staple fell by 100 rupees to 12,000/12,400 rupees per candy (355.56 kg), while wagad cotton fell by 100 to 10,800/10,900 rupees.
Overall market sentiment was subdued at the close and volumes were low.
